d: The British International School Abu Dhabi is seeking an enthusiastic, dynamic, and adaptable Biology Teacher to join our dedicated team of educators. The successful candidate will be passionate about inspiring a love of learning, committed to high standards of teaching and pastoral care, and eager to contribute to the wider life of our thriving international school community.
The closing date for applications is the 06th January 2027
q: You will be a teacher who is passionate about their profession and seeks continuous improvement. You will have a positive mindset and will always do your very best for students, for parents and for colleagues. You will have strong experience of the UK national curriculum; further experience of international education will be an added advantage.

You will be an excellent communicator who will work well with all members of the community. You will have a strong focus on being the best teacher you can be and will also participate fully in the extracurricular aspects of school life. You will be responsible for encouraging and developing further our culture of inspiration, enjoyment and success. Keen to collaborate and share your expertise, you will have good interpersonal skills and the ability and confidence to build strong working relationships. The flexibility and open-mindedness required to adapt quickly to a fast-paced international environment are essential.

Our school follows the English national curriculum to IGCSE and the IB Diploma Programme post-16. The successful candidate will be able to inspire students of all ages and abilities. Classroom resources are plentiful, and expectations are high for achievement for all students. Building and maintaining positive relationships with parents is essential and is a key part of maximizing student progress. More details about the role and requirements can be found in the job description - Subject Teacher JD.pdf

Nord Anglia Education is the world’s leading premium school’s organization, with 90 schools located across over 37 countries in the Americas, Europe, China, Southeast Asia, India and the Middle East. Together, our schools educate over 103,000 students from foundation stage through to the end of secondary school.

Our philosophy for education rests on our four pillars of creativity, wellbeing, excellent academic outcomes, and global connectedness. These are delivered through innovative use of educational technology to create a personalized 21st century learning experience for all students.

Every parent wants the best for their child — so do we. Nord Anglia schools deliver high quality, transformational education and ensure excellent academic outcomes by going beyond traditional learning. Our global scale enables us to recruit and retain world-leading teachers and to offer unforgettable experiences through global and regional events, while our engaging learning environments ensure all of our students love coming to school.
As a Nord Anglia Education teacher, you enjoy the following benefits
A fast-paced, global experience so that you can progress on a global scale
An enabling environment founded on creativity, challenge, and collaboration
A culture that is fair and consultative
Unique opportunities to grow professionally and develop your career.

As an employer, our aim is to create an environment where colleagues are welcomed and are able to bring talents, skills, background and experiences to their roles in an open and inclusive workplace where people from all backgrounds work together with dignity and respect.
Applicants should submit a CV, letter of application and the details of two professional referees, one of which should be your current Head Teacher/Principal.

At Nord Anglia Education we are committed to providing a world-class, safe, happy environment in which children and young people are able to thrive and learn. We are committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of all our pupils irrespective of race, ability, religion, gender or culture. All post holders having regular unsupervised contact with children are subject to appropriate national and international vetting procedures including satisfactory criminal record checks from both Country of residence/birth and any Country of residence within the last 10 years.
x: The British International School (BIS) Abu Dhabi is an outstanding-rated school for students aged 3-18, offering a blend of English and international curricula, including the English National Curriculum, IGCSE, IB Diploma Programme (IBDP), and BTEC International Level 3 Extended Diploma. To find out more about our school, visit bisabudhabi.com or contact our admissions team through this link.

When you join a Nord Anglia Education school, you join a global community of over 22,000 people working together to support our students’ success. We offer you unsurpassed opportunities to innovate and develop best practice across our family, to access extensive professional development, and to gain exceptional experience and career development in our schools. At Nord Anglia, you will have opportunities to progress more, learn more, and collaborate more.

We offer exceptional career and development opportunities that come with being part of our global organization. Our online Nord Anglia University unites our team by harnessing the collective expertise of peers in an exchange of knowledge, ideas, and best practice. We also provide extensive professional development through Nord Anglia University to ensure that our teachers don’t just maintain their skills but can also develop at the cutting edge of educational thinking.

Our world-renowned collaborations with The Juilliard School, MIT, UNICEF, and King’s College London offer our teachers unrivalled access to leading experts in their fields. We also offer selected candidates an opportunity to earn an Executive master’s in international education at King’s College London.
Alongside great training and a competitive package, you’ll enjoy the chance to live and work in one of the world’s most vibrant cities.

d: Location: Bahrain; Kuwait; Oman; Qatar; Saudi Arabia; Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates; Dubai, United Arab Emirates; Sharjah, United Arab Emirates

Timeless Group of Companies is a family-owned retail, distribution, trading, and investment group based in Dubai, founded in 2003. Its aim is to empower and elevate established and emerging brands in the retail world through distribution and strategic brand-building services. The group’s vision is to become a go-to partner for retail and distribution solutions, known for excellence, integrity, and fostering a community of thriving brands. Through subsidiaries including Times Square Group and J.S.K Trading Limited, Timeless holds exclusive distribution, procurement, and master-franchise rights for premium and luxury international fashion, sports, and lifestyle brands across the Middle East and adjacent regions. Its work spans retail, distribution, trading, investments, and real estate, connecting international brands with regional markets. The company’s values include People, Honesty, Creativity, Transparency, Operations, and Leadership. Timeless describes diversity as a strength, with a team of cultures and talents that supports creativity and innovation. Its workforce approach emphasizes inclusion, cultural diversity, mentorship, and equitable opportunity.

As a Senior Marketing Executive, you will lead integrated marketing campaigns and regional brand strategy for a retail and distribution group working with premium and luxury international fashion, sports, and lifestyle brands. You will plan sports partnership activations, manage digital marketing channels, and coordinate events and sponsorships that strengthen brand presence across regional markets. The role combines 360-degree marketing with content planning, audience and market insight, and campaign analytics. You will oversee content production schedules and collaborate with regional stakeholders to align marketing activity with brand objectives and local market needs. This full-time, on-site position is based in the United Arab Emirates, with work connected to the group’s Dubai operations. You will bring senior-level experience, a marketing education, and the ability to connect brand strategy with effective execution across digital, social, content, and live experiences.
q: Demonstrated capability in 360-degree marketing and integrated marketing campaigns, with the ability to connect strategy, channel plans, and execution into cohesive brand activity.
Sports marketing expertise, including planning partnership activations and coordinating sponsorship activity that supports brand objectives and audience engagement.
Brand strategy and regional marketing skills, including the ability to adapt brand direction to relevant markets while maintaining consistent positioning.
Digital marketing and social media marketing experience, with sound judgment in managing channels and aligning activity with broader campaign plans.
Content marketing skills, including overseeing production schedules and coordinating content requirements to support campaigns across channels.
Event marketing experience, with the ability to coordinate events and sponsorships and keep relevant participants aligned on delivery.
Market research and campaign analytics capability, including analyzing performance metrics and using findings to inform marketing decisions.
Stakeholder management skills, including collaboration with regional stakeholders and clear communication across campaign planning and execution.
Experience working with retail, retail apparel and fashion, sporting goods, or sports, leisure, and recreation organizations is advantageous.
Exposure to premium or luxury international fashion, sports, or lifestyle brands and regional market expansion would be useful.
Experience coordinating sports partnerships and sponsorship activations across regional markets is an advantage.
A Bachelor of Business Administration with a specialization or field of study in Marketing, supporting a strong foundation for brand and campaign work.
Seven to ten years of relevant experience in marketing, including senior-level ownership of integrated or 360-degree campaigns.
Fluent English communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with regional stakeholders.
A practical, organized approach to managing overlapping campaign, content, digital, event, and sponsorship priorities in an on-site, full-time role.
r: Lead integrated, 360-degree marketing campaigns across relevant channels, aligning campaign plans with brand objectives and regional market needs. Coordinate execution and maintain visibility of key deliverables.

Develop regional brand strategies for premium and luxury international fashion, sports, and lifestyle brands. Translate strategic direction into marketing plans suited to regional audiences and business priorities.
Plan sports partnership activations and coordinate sponsorship activity, ensuring the agreed marketing elements are organized and delivered in support of brand presence and engagement.
Manage digital marketing channels, including social media activity, and oversee content production schedules. Coordinate content requirements and timelines across the campaign calendar.
Coordinate marketing events and sponsorships, bringing together relevant internal and external stakeholders. Support consistent brand representation across activations and live experiences.
Analyze campaign performance metrics and market research to assess results and inform future marketing decisions. Share findings with stakeholders to guide improvements.
Collaborate with regional stakeholders to align campaign plans, channel activity, and brand priorities. Maintain clear communication throughout planning and execution.
x: At Timeless Group of Companies, you can contribute to the growth of established and emerging brands through distribution and strategic brand-building work across the Middle East and adjacent regions. The group’s portfolio spans premium and luxury fashion, sports, lifestyle, investments, and brand-building, creating exposure to international brands and regional market expansion. You will work within a family-run business with more than 20 years of market legacy and a multicultural team that values people, honesty, creativity, transparency, operations, and leadership. Timeless highlights mentors with more than 25 years of industry experience, alongside a commitment to career growth, training, and development. Its stated approach emphasizes collaborative teamwork and hands-on leadership, providing opportunities to contribute ideas and engage with marketing work that reaches a broad regional retail network. The company also describes diversity and inclusion as important to its culture, with mentorship and equitable opportunity among its workforce priorities. This role offers a platform to apply integrated marketing and sports marketing expertise while supporting regional brand-building and partnership activity.
Exposure to international premium and luxury fashion, sports, and lifestyle brands, with opportunities to contribute to regional market expansion and brand-building.
A collaborative, multicultural working environment that emphasizes hands-on leadership, creativity, mentorship, and teamwork.
Career growth, training, and development opportunities, with access to mentors who have more than 25 years of industry experience.

d: Saudi German Health is hiring - Senior Network Security Engineer - Jeddah
We are looking for an experienced Senior Network Security Engineer to join our team and support the security of our enterprise network, endpoints, remote access, and applications.
The ideal candidate will bring strong hands-on experience across network and endpoint security, with particular expertise in Palo Alto, Cisco ISE/NAC, EDR, WAF, and ZTNA technologies.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
10 years of experience in IT Security.
Strong hands-on experience with Palo Alto firewalls and Cisco ISE .
Experience with EDR, WAF, NAC, ZTNA, and endpoint security/hardening .
Strong understanding of enterprise network security and threat detection.
Strong troubleshooting, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Preferred certifications: CCNP Security, Microsoft Security certifications, or relevant GIAC certifications.
r: Manage and maintain Palo Alto firewalls , security policies, and access controls.
Manage Cisco ISE / Network Access Control (NAC) , including authentication, profiling, posture assessment, and 802.1X policies.
Implement and manage secure remote access through Prisma and Citrix ZTNA .
Configure and manage Web Application Firewall (WAF) solutions and security policies.
Administer Endpoint Detection & Response (EDR) platforms for threat detection, malware prevention, and containment.
Monitor and investigate security alerts and coordinate remediation activities.
Implement endpoint hardening and security policies across Windows, Linux, and macOS environments.
Collaborate with SOC, Threat Intelligence, Network, and Infrastructure teams on security incidents and improvements.
Support compliance with security standards including NCA, ISO 27001, and CIS .
